lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Sanjay Bauer is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Sanjay Bauer is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Sanjay kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Sanjay's gone." Cameron looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Sanjay." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Emmett blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Anatomy (Level 1). You know where the important bits are. Arteries, joints, organs. Useful for healing or hurting.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Grave Robber (Level 1). You can loot the dead (villagers, monsters). Good gear. -15 trust if seen.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Scrounger (Level 1). Ruin looting finds +1 item.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Sanjay Bauer, 41 days. The mantle passes to Emmett Villanueva.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Emmett Villanueva, 26 — a Mortician. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Sanjay — and Sanjay is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Cameron, Ellie, Catalina and 3 more speak for Emmett — "Sanjay trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Emmett before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
